entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philibert Randriambololona was a Madagascan Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Fianarantsoa from 1992 to 2002. He was ordained to the priesthood in 1961 for the Jesuits and served as Coadjutor Bishop of Antsirabe from 1988 to 1989 and as bishop from 1989 to 1992.
